root_cause.summary: PR #7143 added _assert_twse_tpex_openapi_only_url inside services/source_ingestion/connectors/taiwan_official.py::_fetch_official to enforce the operator rule that Pantheon direct egress only contacts TWSE/TPEx OpenAPI endpoints (https://openapi.twse.com.tw/v1/* and https://www.tpex.org.tw/openapi/v1/*). However, two existing unit tests in services/source_ingestion/tests/test_bounded_reader.py (test_taiwan_official_connector_call_path_handles_short_chunk at line 127 and test_taiwan_official_connector_call_path_oversized_payload at line 146) passed synthetic urllib.request.Request('https://www.twse.com.tw/test') into _fetch_official, which triggered SourceEvidenceError ('Pantheon forbids direct requests to non-OpenAPI TWSE website endpoint: https://www.twse.com.tw/test') before reaching open_external_url and read_bounded_response.

resolution.delivery_strategy: Per AUTO_INTEGRATOR_UNBLOCK_DELIVERY_RULE, when the defect is in the source PR's own changes, start from origin/dev and restate the needed source task changes together with the fix from this repair task's own branch and PR without pushing to the source task branch.
resolution.code_fix: Updated the two synthetic Request URLs in services/source_ingestion/tests/test_bounded_reader.py from 'https://www.twse.com.tw/test' to 'https://openapi.twse.com.tw/v1/exchangeReport/TWTB4U' so _fetch_official passes the OpenAPI-only URL guard and exercises bounded response reading and max_bytes enforcement.
